scientific_integrity: Exact proof and numerical validation are distinguished; known sphere and spheroid distance distributions, and fixed-gap extremal-distance exponents, are credited to prior work.
scientific_limitations: The dimension, positive distance cutoff and contraction vector are fixed; the absolute error is uniform only over bounded contraction vectors and bounded positive thresholds.
The large-contraction multiplicity match is a limit of the crossover coefficient, not a simultaneous two-parameter limit.
The isolated dimension-three profile is implied by an earlier exact spheroid distance-distribution integral; it is not independently claimed as new.
An independent mathematical audit and complete historical-priority adjudication have not been performed.
title: Uniform near-diameter crossover and sharp anisotropy ordering for ellipsoids
